wav2code_HubertTokenizer: use HubertTokenizer to convert a WAV audio file path into discrete speech unit codes
wav2codes_HubertTokenizer: use HubertTokenizer to extract speech unit codes from both channels of a stereo WAV file
code2wav_HifiganVocoder: use HifiganVocoder to synthesize a WAV audio waveform from a sequence of discrete speech codes
codes2wav_HifiganVocoder: use HifiganVocoder to synthesize a stereo WAV waveform from two sets of speech codes with speaker IDs
init_HubertTokenizer: initialize a HubertTokenizer with a HuBERT model path, layer index, and k-means cluster path
